Card Q&A.a: The player that activated this card's effect chooses.
Card Q&A.q: Which player chooses whether to return the card revealed from my opponent’s security stack by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to the top or bottom of the security stack?

Effect: [On Play][When Digivolving] Reveal the top card of your opponent's security stack. If that card is a Digimon card, gain 1 memory. If it's a non-Digimon card, ＜Draw 1＞. Place the revealed card at the top or bottom of your opponent’s security stack face down.
[All Turns] While there's a Tamer, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ and can't be deleted by your opponent's effects.
